rationale.hitl-workflow: Users set enforcement levels, inspect checkpoints, and can pause or redirect agents.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Zoro surfaces plans, rule evidence, code artifacts, and test results.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Step protocols and supervision detect and bound departures from plans and rules.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Strict testable rules use unit tests and deterministic CLI hard stops.
rationale.ai-review: Agent-generated evidence and tests judge whether implementations satisfy active rules.
rationale.remediation-gating: Hard stops force autonomous correction before an agent may advance.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent records link rules, plans, code evidence, tests, and feedback.
